title: Parallel Line and Transversal
text:
When a line is parallel to one side of a triangle and intersects the other two sides, it creates a smaller similar triangle.

ST || QR creates corresponding angles with transversals PQ and PR.

title: Similarity Criteria
text:
**AAA (Angle-Angle-Angle):** If all three angles of one triangle equal the three angles of another triangle, the triangles are similar.

We have shown all three pairs of angles are equal:
- Angle P = Angle P (common)
- Angle PST = Angle PQR (corresponding)
- Angle PTS = Angle PRQ (corresponding)
